detail: uBOAssets.android.json selects fanboy-cookiemonster, ublock-cookies-easylist by default; no self-update URL, uBO keeps the bootstrapped catalog
bundled uBO knows fanboy-cookiemonster (EasyList – Cookie Notices); ublock-cookies-easylist (uBlock filters – Cookie Notices)
ExtensionStorageIDB.sys.mjs + Extension.sys.mjs turn the lists on once in older profiles (librewolf.uBO.cookieListsMigrated)
